dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Saxophone arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to have a low threshold for arousal. Noted to head whip and mouth handlers on the handler. Saxophone has also been observed to jump up and attempt to mouth handlers on the arm. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Saxophone
